overview: Baby creepers, grown from the lawn: creepers burst into spores instead of craters, and the grass they reach sprouts babies.

1.0.0: A creeper's blast hurts as it always did but breaks no blocks, and leaves a green fog of spores where the crater would have been.

Grass and tall grass the fog reaches is sometimes infected: it puffs spores, and a baby creeper hatches where it was, either a minute or two later or, as often, not until the next night. Break or mow it first and nothing hatches.
Baby creepers are half-size, half the health, half again as fast, with half the blast. With Pandorical they are drawn as babies: a big head on a short body.
A creeper spawn egg used on a creeper hatches a baby creeper.
Baby creepers grow up after twenty minutes. A golden dandelion keeps one a baby and makes it friendly: it never goes after anyone, even someone who hits it. A second dandelion lets it go.
